mentions.name: docking
mentions.description: A Linux dockbar that supports both X11 and Wayland, featuring 60+ built-in applets and fairly good customization, aiming to combine the best qualities of dockbars used over the decades.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am still working on a Linux dockbar for X11 and Wayland, it has all the goods of dockbars I have been using throughout the decades now, 60+ applets baked in, fairly good customization, etc
mentions.author: edumucelli
